title: WorkstreamDispatchResult
description: Closed v1 portable result envelope for the Workstream Dispatch protocol. Mirrors the registration result envelope shape (version, outcome, effects, optional diagnostics with the same bounded caps) but with a dispatch-local outcome enum. Readers dispatch on the required integer `version` before applying the closed schema. Outcome names are frozen: dispatched, partial-success, cancelled, stopped, invalid-workspace, and internal-failure. Bounded everywhere: every string has a maxLength cap, every array a maxItems cap, and `additionalProperties: false` at every object level.

version.description: Result contract version; readers dispatch on it before applying the closed schema. v1 allowed value: 1.

outcome.description: Protocol outcome name, frozen at v1. `dispatched`: job record written and agent spawned. `partial-success`: job record written but spawn failed (R4). `cancelled`: confirmation mismatch or rejection (R2). `stopped`: record-write failure before spawn. `invalid-workspace`: unregistered or invalid-marker workspace (R5). `internal-failure`: safe internal error with stable code.

job_id.description: The job identity, present when the outcome is `dispatched` or `partial-success`.

diagnostics.description: Bounded structured diagnostics (KTD13, KTD9). Native error messages are never emitted; diagnostics carry only phase, stable code, bounded safe path, count, and optional bounded label.

count.description: Number of diagnostic items (always equals items length).

phase.description: Operation phase where the diagnostic originated.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (never native error text).

safe_path.description: Bounded safe path (no URI content, no secrets).
